title: StartHalo sl8-* E2B templates registry
description: Public, machine-readable inventory of the sl8-* family of E2B sandbox templates and their tool packs. Generated from StartHalo/sl8-tools and mirrored to StartHalo/sl8-templates. See docs/features/e2b-templates-registry/ in sl8-tools for full documentation.

schemaVersion.description: Major schema version. Incompatible changes bump this; consumers MAY refuse to parse files whose version they don't understand.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this snapshot was generated.

sourceCommit.description: Full 40-char git SHA of the sl8-tools commit this snapshot was generated from, or the literal 'uncommitted' for ad-hoc local runs.

templates.description: Every active sl8-* template, sorted with sl8-base first then alphabetically.

archivedTemplates.description: Templates that used to exist and have been replaced.

TemplateEntry.description: An active sl8-* template. Either has `components` (base templates) or `base` + `packs` (variant templates).

name.description: Template name. Matches the directory under e2b/ in sl8-tools AND the generic alias.

status.description: Currently always 'active'. Archived templates live in archivedTemplates. Reserved field for future statuses.

currentVersion.description: Timestamped version (vYYYYMMDD-HHMMSS) currently promoted for this template.

versioned.description: Pinned alias — '<name>-<currentVersion>'. Use for reproducible jobs. Never auto-updates.

generic.description: Floating alias equal to `name`. Resolves to whatever is currently promoted. Auto-updates on every promotion.

components.description: Installed tools/runtimes on a base template (e.g. sl8-base). Mutually exclusive with `packs`.

name.description: Canonical package name (e.g. '@anthropic-ai/claude-code') or runtime label ('Node.js', 'gcsfuse').

version.description: Version pinned at template build time. May be a full semver, a major-only marker ('20.x'), or 'system' for OS-provided components.

base.description: The base template this variant inherits from. Present on variants; absent on base templates.

version.description: Exact base version this variant's template.ts pins via fromTemplate(...).

packs.description: Tool packs layered on top of the base, in install order. Mutually exclusive with `components`.

ui.description: Optional curated display copy (name, emoji, tagline, capability chips, per-package blurbs) for use in pickers and info popovers. Absent for runtimes that haven't been curated yet; consumers MUST fall back to derived defaults in that case.

Ui.description: Curated display copy for a runtime. All fields optional; consumers apply derived defaults when absent. Authored in e2b/<template>/ui.json and embedded verbatim by the registry generator.

displayName.description: Short human label shown in pickers, badges, headers (e.g. 'Animation'). One or two words; Title Case; avoid 'Template'/'Runtime'.

emoji.description: Single grapheme used as a quick visual identifier (e.g. '🎬'). Avoid flags or politically-loaded symbols.

tagline.description: One-line value prop shown on the picker card. Frame as value, not feature list.

description.description: Multi-sentence body text for info popovers / detail pages. Two to four sentences: what it is, what's notable, when to pick it.

capabilities.description: Short capability chips. Noun phrases or product names; six is the sweet spot.

packageOverrides.description: Per-component or per-pack friendly text, keyed by component.name (base templates) or pack.id (variant templates). Unknown keys are an authoring error.

name.description: Override of the technical name for display.

blurb.description: One friendly sentence aimed at a non-technical user. Skip the version — it's shown separately.

technical.description: Appendix-grade text for a 'show details' panel. Include version, key flags, operational caveats.

PackEntry.description: A tool pack layered onto a variant template.

id.description: Stable ID (matches the pack directory under e2b/tool-packs/).

version.description: Semver. Bumped when install behaviour or agentGuidance changes.

agentGuidance.description: Concrete usage instructions for skills/agents using this pack's tooling. Also baked into /etc/sl8/capabilities.json inside the sandbox.

replacedBy.description: Current template consumers should use instead.
